# Fast Frame XY Plot

## What it does
Plots one fast-frame CSV variable against another variable.

## Creation (settings)
- Title: Widget title.
- CSV Directory / CSV File Path: CSV file to watch.
- Refresh Rate: Poll interval used to reload the selected file.
- X Variable / Y Variable: Variables used for the XY pair.
- Axis labels and bounds: Optional axis overrides.

## Usage (in dashboard)
- Configure this widget with the Fast Frame UI widget.
- The plot reloads automatically when the selected CSV file changes.
